answer:
A Master's degree in Library Science from an American Library Association accredited college or university and seven years of professional library experience, with three of those in an administrative capacity in a moderate to large library system

Highly qualified candidates will have a second degree in Business, Public Administration or HR, management experience in a public library system with multiple sites, successful experience with fundraising and library elections, and experience providing library service to diverse communities
